=== quality-sweep ===
--- cmd: probe-quality-sweep
DSH-SIGNAL quality.sweep.done=true（core_hash 仅覆盖 content/reasoning/finish；snapshot 用于把异常样本与 spec_decode/抢占/缓存计数关联）
DSH-SIGNAL quality.sweep.valid=0/8 (有效样本数：n/a 的不是样本，不能计入一致性判定)
=== end:quality-sweep ===
